blockers.description: G-02-5 (major): weight/HR/temperature charts start Y-axis at 0 instead of scaling to period min/max — undermines the project's core value of 'clear, honest charts'
blockers.workaround: Recharts YAxis domain needs to be computed from the filtered dataset's min/max for the selected period rather than left at default [0, auto]

blockers.description: G-02-4 (major): logging for a date that already has a value doesn't surface the existing value — risk of silent duplicate/overwrite entries
blockers.workaround: On date selection in the log form, query Dexie for an existing entry on that date and prefill the editable value field if found

blockers.description: G-02-3 (minor): weight log form doesn't prefill the last logged value as a starting point
blockers.workaround: Query the most recent weight entry and prefill the input on form open
